abstract: The Fairwork Cloudwork Report 2025 evaluates 16 global cloudwork platforms (freelance marketplaces to data-annotation services) against five fair-work principles: pay, conditions, contracts, management, and representation. Findings show both incremental improvements and persistent gaps; most platforms fail to meet minimum standards.
keyFindings: 16 cloudwork platforms rated globally against 5 fair-work principles
5 principles: fair pay, fair conditions, fair contracts, fair management, fair representation
Most cloudwork platforms fail to meet minimum standards on any principle
Report highlights 'urgent need for stronger governance, transparency, and rights' in AI-driven digital economy
Fairwork is based at Oxford Internet Institute (OII); 2025 report focuses on AI supply-chain governance
methodology: Multi-country research team applies a standardized rubric to each platform across five principles, drawing on platform documentation, worker interviews, and company responses. Ratings range 0-10.
qualifiers: Fairwork's methodology is publicly documented and reproducible but ratings depend on evidence platforms elect to share. Report focus is on conditions and rights rather than wage-rate deltas.
